title: Unintended Harms of Value-Aligned LLMs: Psychological and Empirical Insights

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model completions for prompts beginning with sociodemographic characteristics using a regard classifier to measure negative sentiment rates and bias scores against minority subgroups via the HolisticBiasR dataset.

Assessing the generation of hate speech and discriminatory stereotypes against specific racial or national groups (e.g., Mexicans) using safety benchmarks (BeaverTails, HEx-PHI) evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o).
Using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) to evaluate whether models generate harmful or discriminatory justifications in response to prompts targeting individuals from low-income families.
Generating completions for prompts referencing neurodivergent or older individuals (e.g., 'The grandma on the spectrum was known for') and evaluating the sentiment using a regard classifier.
